records.title: AIサイバー攻撃にどう備えるか--ソフトバンク宮川CEOが「シカゴ大火」から説くモダナイゼーションの急務
records.excerpt: ソフトバンクが開催した法人向けイベント「SoftBank World 2026」において、同社代表取締役 社長執行役員 兼 最高経営責任者（CEO）の宮川潤一氏は、生成AIの進化が企業システムにもたらす変革と、それに伴うセキュリティリスクについて講演した。 ソフトバンク 代表取締役 社長執行役員 兼 最高経営責任者（CEO）の宮川潤一氏 宮川氏は、従来の人間中心の開発思想から脱却し、AIを前提としたシステム全体の刷新、モダナイゼーションの実行こそが、企業の存続と日本全体の社会基盤を守る道であると力説した。 シカゴ大火に学ぶ「復旧」から「刷新」への思想転換 宮川氏は講演の冒頭、米国シカゴで1871年に発生した大火災（シカゴ大火）の歴史を紹介した。3日間の大火で東京ドーム約170個分に相当するエリアが焼け野原と化したが、シカゴはこの災害からわずか100年後、世界を代表する摩天楼都市へと生まれ変わった。この復興を主導したのが、当時のシカゴ市長であったJoseph Medill（ジョセフ・メディル）氏と、近代高層建築の父と称されるWilliam Le Baron Jenney（ウィリアム・ル・バロン・ジェニー）氏の2人だ。 Medill氏は火災が起きてから対処するのではなく、そもそも燃えない街をルールとインフラの双方から再設計することを目指した。そしてJenney氏は、金属フレームや耐火材料、エレベーター、大型窓といった最先端技術を組み合わせ、木造から脱却した不燃の高層ビル建築を生み出した。 宮川氏はこの歴史的教訓を、現代の企業システムに重ね合わせ、「シカゴには元の街並みを再現する選択肢もあったが、彼らが選んだのは木造という旧来の基盤を捨て、一から新しい不燃の基盤へと刷新する道だった」と強調した。 シカゴが選んだ道 宮川氏は「今、企業システムにもこれと全く同様の課題を感じている。止まってから復旧する力ではなく、企業システム全体を止まらない基盤へと刷新することが求められている」と語り、既存の延長線上でのセキュリティ対策に限界がきていることを示した。 実際にソフトバンクグループ傘下のLINEヤフーの連結子会社であるアスクルでは、サイバー攻撃によってシステムが全停止し、受注や出荷業務に多大な打撃を受けた。同氏はこの事例に触れ、サイバーリスクは決して他人事ではないと強調する。 サイバー攻撃による業務停止や売り上げ減少は一時的な被害にとどまらず、企業の社会的信頼を失墜させ、企業の継続性そのものを脅かす。宮川氏は「サイバーセキュリティこそが、昨今議論されているサステナビリティーの『一丁目一番地』に該当するのではないか」と危機感を示した。 AGIの衝撃と急加速する知能の進化 企業のシステム刷新が急務とされる最大の背景には、生成AIの進化スピードの加速がある。2023年頃の初期の「ChatGPT」が扱えたのはテキストのみだったが、現在は画像や音声をはじめとするマルチモーダルな情報を処理できるようになり、さらにAIが自律的に考えて判断し行動する「AIエージェント」へと変化を遂げている。 この進化スピードは、人類の歴史と比較すると際立つ。人間が第1次産業革命から現在までの約250年間をかけて緩やかに知能を進化させ、知能指数を向上させてきたのに対し、AIはわずか3年足らずでその進化の軌跡を駆け抜けてしまった。宮川氏は「もはや人類は、AIの処理能力には追いつけないと感じている。これからはAIと共存し、彼らとどう向き合っていくのかという時代」と指摘する。 すでに最高峰レベルのAIは人間の上位層に匹敵する極めて高い知能指数を有していると推測されており、今後1年以内には人類全体の英知をしのぐ汎用（はんよう）AI（AGI）が誕生すると予言されている。 AGIの誕生を境に、世界は「プレAGI時代」から「ポストAGI時代」へと完全に移行する。宮川氏は、AGIレベルの頭脳を持った自動運転車や産業用ロボットが日常に溶け込む未来を見据え、孫正義氏が唱えるスーパーヒューマン時代について「知能の神様のような存在。人工超知能（ASI）は知能のさらに先にある、知性を持つことを意味するのではないか」と独自の見解を述べ、その知性との共生に向けた準備が企業のデジタル基盤に問われているとした。 実用段階へ突入した次世代AIエージェント 基調講演では、すでにビジネスの現場で稼働しているAIエージェントの驚異的な実力が2つのデモを通じて示された。まず披露したのは、ソフトバンクが開発を推進する国産大規模言語モデル（LLM）「Sarashina（サラシナ）」を用いたコミュニケーション支援だ。Sarashinaは膨大な日本語データを学習しており、歴史的な語彙（ごい）や四字熟語、固有名詞などを正確に理解する高度な日本語処理能力を持つ。 国産大規模言語モデル（LLM）「Sarashina（サラシナ）」 デモでは、宮川氏自身の話し言葉を約0.5秒の遅延でリアルタイムに通訳し、事前に1分間日本語音声を学習させただけのボイスクローン技術を用いて、宮川氏本人の声色で英語をスピーチする様子が実演された。 宮川氏は「日本語特化という言葉は海外のモデルと比較してみると違いがよく分かる。Sarashinaは日本語を深く学習しているため、アナウンサーレベルの自然な発音に達している」と自信を見せ、さらにすでに8カ国語に対応していることから、クリック1つで自身の声による多言語発信が可能になったと説明した。 日本語性能比較 続いて紹介したのが、コールセンター業務を変える自律型AIエージェントだ。ソフトバンクが展開する「X-Ghost（クロスゴースト）」は、マニュアル化されていない現場の暗黙知をAIとの対話によって学習させ、企業の顧客対応を常にアップデートし続ける。 さらにソフトバンクは、世界的にAIコールセンター事業を展開するSierra（シエラ）との国内における事業連携を発表した。Sierraのシステムはわずか2週間の開発期間で実稼働に至るというスピードを特徴とする。 実際の検証電話デモでは、利用者が通信料金の高騰に不満を抱き解約を申し出るシーンが再現された。AIエージェントは利用者の本人確認をSMS経由で瞬時に行い、契約プランの割引期間終了という原因を特定した。 さらに、利用者の「基本的にはスマホで動画を見る」という普段の使い方を聞き出し、通信速度が十分でありながら月額2750円安くなる最適なプランを瞬時に判断して解約を踏みとどまらせ、プラン変更手続き用のリンクを即座に送信した。 一連のオペレーションにおいてAIは一切の詰まりや不自然さを感じさせず、人間と同等以上のホスピタリティーと判断力を見せた。宮川氏は「このシステム精度であれば、すでに実力レベルに達していると感じてもらえたのではないか。非常に優れたAIエージェントが背景に存在しているからこそ、わずか2週間でのシステム導入が可能になる」と、その実用性を評した。

records.title: SoftBank launches GaranAI to convert news for generative AI
records.excerpt: SoftBank is piloting a new service that transforms publisher content into AI training data. The move raises questions about copyright safeguards. As reported by the online media Ukrinform. SoftBank has launched a new information platform, GaranAI, which collects data from materials published by various publications and news agencies and processes them for use in generative […] SoftBank launches GaranAI to convert news for generative AI Thursday, 23 July 2026, 06:53 SoftBank is piloting a new service that transforms publisher content into AI training data. The move raises questions about copyright safeguards. As reported by the online media Ukrinform . SoftBank has launched a new information platform, GaranAI, which collects data from materials published by various publications and news agencies and processes them for use in generative artificial intelligence. The pilot project, named GaranAI, aims to enable the use of news in the further development of artificial intelligence, while protecting intellectual property rights. Content for the platform will be provided by Mainichi Newspapers, Sankei Shimbun, Kyodo News and some local publications, and they will receive compensation for it. Content Partners Mainichi Newspapers Sankei Shimbun Kyodo News some local publications The platform will convert the material into a format that makes it difficult to reconstruct the original text, and then transform it into data that AI can use before selling them to AI developers. This step comes amid growing concerns about copyright infringement and the spread of disinformation. Development plan and future plans SoftBank plans to refine the platform over the next six months, after which the final version is planned to be launched in January of the following year or later. In addition, the company aims to expand the platform so that it accepts materials from various fields, including online media and museums, in order to make it an indispensable tool for the development and improvement of generative artificial intelligence. The new platform is expected to be an important step in the development of generative artificial intelligence, providing access to a variety of sources while respecting authors’ rights and reducing the risks of disinformation. records.excerpt: Arm Holdings (ARM) shares are on track to end a three-day winning streak in Wednesday's premarket trading as semiconductor stocks broadly declined ahead of earnings from Magnificent Seven members Alphabet Inc. and Tesla Inc. (TSLA).According to TheFly, Wells Fargo lowered the price target for Arm t… ARM Stock Takes A Breather After Three Days Of Gains — Wells Fargo Cuts Price Target, Warning Of A 'Tough Setup' Ahead 2 min read ARM Key points: Wells Fargo expects little change to Arm's outlook for roughly 20% year-over-year revenue growth in fiscal 2027. While robust AI-driven demand from data centers should remain a tailwind, Wells Fargo believes continued weakness in the smartphone and PC markets will offset those gains. Arm CEO Rene Haas said during the company's fourth-quarter earnings call that global mobile unit growth could “slip to negative,” with the smartphone market staying very flattish to slightly negative. Arm Holdings (ARM) shares are on track to end a three-day winning streak in Wednesday's premarket trading as semiconductor stocks broadly declined ahead of earnings from Magnificent Seven members Alphabet Inc. and Tesla Inc. (TSLA). According to TheFly, Wells Fargo lowered the price target for Arm to $350 from $410 while maintaining an ‘Overweight’ rating on the stock. The new price target implies a potential upside of 23% from current levels. Arm’s American Depositary Receipts were down more than 1% in Wednesday morning’s trade. Why Wells Fargo Trimmed Its ARM Price Target Wells Fargo said that Arm faces a "tough setup" heading into its next earnings report. The firm expects little change to Arm's outlook for roughly 20% year-over-year revenue growth in fiscal 2027. While robust AI-driven demand from data centers should remain a tailwind, Wells Fargo believes continued weakness in the smartphone and PC markets will offset those gains, limiting the potential for meaningful upward revisions to the company's guidance. Wells Fargo's view echoes commentary from Arm CEO Rene Haas during the company’s fourth-quarter (Q4) earnings call. Haas said Arm expects global mobile unit growth to “slip to negative” in the near term, with the broader smartphone market remaining “very flattish, maybe slightly negative.” He added that the weakness is expected to be concentrated in the lower end of the smartphone market and should be more than offset by continued demand for Arm-based chips powering cloud AI and data center workloads. Arm is scheduled to report its first-quarter (Q1) results on July 29. Wall Street expects the company to report earnings per share (EPS) of $0.4 on revenue of $1.26 billion, according to Fiscal.ai data. Arm reported EPS of $0.35 on revenue of $1.05 billion during the same period a year ago. Not Everyone Is As Cautious On ARM Not all analysts share Wells Fargo's cautious outlook. According to a report by Investing.com, Jefferies on Monday reiterated its ‘Buy’ rating on Arm and raised its price target to $320 from $290. The firm raised its long-term AGI revenue expectations for Arm to $18 billion by 2031, compared to Arm’s guidance of $15 billion, citing stronger demand fueled by the rise of agentic AI and customer wins with Oracle and ByteDance. Jefferies also pointed to the potential launch of a SoftBank GPU based on Arm's design services next year as another catalyst that could boost royalty revenue. Meanwhile, Susquehanna also struck a more bullish tone, raising its price target on Arm to $320 from $300, while maintaining a ‘Positive’ rating. The firm expects semiconductor companies to post modest upside in the second quarter (Q2) and believes an accelerating industry upcycle and improving pricing dynamics could provide a stronger backdrop for the sector in the third quarter (Q3). How Retail Traders Reacted To ARM Stock Retail sentiment on Stocktwits around ARM was in the ‘bearish’ territory at the time of writing. ARM stock is up 158% year-to-date and 77% over the past 12 months. The iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX) is up 129% over the past 12 months, while the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) is up 107%. The Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) is up 26% during this period, while the Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X Shares (SOXL) is up 520%. records.title: Jefferies Boosts Arm Holdings (NASDAQ: ARM) Price Target To $320 As AI Demand Fuels CPU Growth Surge
records.excerpt: Arm Holdings PLC (NASDAQ: ARM) is seeing a stronger long-term growth outlook as rising artificial intelligence workloads drive surging demand for CPUs, Arm Holdings PLC (NASDAQ: ARM) is seeing a stronger long-term growth outlook as rising artificial intelligence workloads drive surging demand for CPUs, prompting Jefferies to lift its price target to $320 from $290. The semiconductor designer’s shares have climbed nearly 150% so far this year, with the stock trading at $272 on Monday afternoon. Submit a Press Release or News Tip Jefferies cited Arm’s expanded AI-related CPU opportunity following the company’s fiscal 2026 results, pointing to growing demand from agentic AI applications and new customer additions including Oracle and ByteDance. The firm now projects Arm’s AI CPU revenue will reach $18 billion in fiscal 2031, exceeding the company’s own guidance of $15 billion. Jefferies also raised its outlook for the total addressable CPU market, estimating it could reach $200 billion by 2030, up sharply from a prior estimate of more than $100 billion. The analyst firm expects Arm’s AI CPUs to capture at least a 15% share of that expanded market, with Meta projected to become the company’s largest customer, followed by OpenAI, Oracle, and ByteDance. Jefferies revised its AI CPU revenue estimates upward for fiscal 2028 and fiscal 2029, forecasting $1.5 billion and $3 billion respectively, compared with previous estimates of $1.4 billion and $2.7 billion. The firm noted that Arm could expand production capacity through higher-cost wafer supply options, which may pressure gross margins but help the company secure a larger share of the growing AI chip market. Data centers represent another significant growth avenue, with Jefferies noting that Arm’s compute subsystem-based royalties have increased to $1.50 per core, up from $1 previously, supporting stronger royalty revenue across Arm-based infrastructure. Jefferies also flagged a potential AI accelerator launch from SoftBank using Arm’s design services as a future royalty opportunity, with royalties from such products potentially exceeding $7,000 per chip given high GPU average selling prices, though volumes remain difficult to predict. The firm forecasts Arm’s revenue and earnings will grow at more than 40% annually through fiscal 2031, with a projected five-year earnings per share compound annual growth rate of 45%. Jefferies wrote that the company’s growth visibility and exposure to AI-driven CPU demand could support outperformance relative to the broader semiconductor sector, with its revised price target based on a fiscal 2031 price-to-earnings multiple of 29 times, supported by discounted cash flow analysis. Quantum computing is transitioning from a stage of discussing its theoretical potential to one of demonstrating concrete use cases and clear pathways toward commercialization. This white paper presents the results of a joint research initiative between SoftBank Corp. and Quantinuum, developed under the long-term vision of Quantum AI Data Centers. The transaction is expected to include roughly 50 billion of three-year… SoftBank Seeks 60 Billion Bond Sale Amid Nearly $65 Billion OpenAI Commitment 1 min read ARM 9984 SoftBank Group Corp. (SOBKY), a Japanese company expanding its investments in artificial intelligence, plans to raise about 60 billion ($369 million) through a bond offering to institutional investors in Japan later this month. The transaction is expected to include roughly 50 billion of three-year notes and 10 billion of five-year notes during the week of July 27. Daiwa Securities Co., a Japanese securities firm, will serve as lead manager, while Nomura Securities Co. and SMBC Nikko Securities Inc., two securities companies involved in the offering, will also help arrange the deal. The planned bond sale highlights SoftBank's growing funding requirements as the company increases its exposure to AI investments, including a commitment of almost $65 billion to OpenAI, an artificial intelligence company. SoftBank has already raised 678 billion this year through subordinated bonds sold to retail investors and also accessed the U.S. dollar and euro bond markets in April. The company has separately considered a margin loan backed by its OpenAI stake, although the potential borrowing target has been reduced to around $6 billion from an initial $10 billion. The latest financing comes as investor concerns over returns from AI spending have placed pressure on semiconductor-related stocks, including Arm Holdings Plc ARM , SoftBank's chip-technology subsidiary. SoftBank shares have declined from their early-June peak following reports that OpenAI's initial public offering may be delayed. S&P Global Ratings, a credit-rating agency, revised its outlook on SoftBank to stable from negative on July 16, saying the company's financial position had improved more than previously expected after a sharp increase in Arm's share price. The agency also affirmed SoftBank's BB+ long-term issuer credit rating, leaving the company one level below investment grade. records.label: jp.ibtimes.com
records.title: SoftBank launches GaranAI beta with Kyodo News, newspaper data
records.excerpt: SoftBank opened beta applications for GaranAI, which transforms entrusted content into AI-ready datasets. The platform starts with Kyodo News and seven newspaper publishers. KEY POINTS SoftBank opens beta applications for GaranAI, a data platform for content holders and AI developers GaranAI converts entrusted content into derivative and processed data designed for AI development use Formal launch targets January 2027 or later after beta tests with Kyodo News and seven newspaper publishers SoftBank Corp. on July 22 launched a beta version of GaranAI, a data ecosystem platform designed to let Japanese content holders provide data for generative AI development while protecting rights through multi-stage processing, according to a company statement.The company began accepting applications the same day from both content holders and data users. SoftBank plans to use the beta phase to test data usage with participating data users based on datasets provided by a limited group of content holders, with a formal launch targeted for January 2027 or later.GaranAI is built to take entrusted data from content holders such as newspapers, publishers, web service operators and entertainment companies, and convert it into "derivative data" that preserves gist and factual relationships while altering wording and structure to make restoration of the original data difficult. Data users can then access "processed data," reformatted from that derivative data for AI development purposes.The platform will distribute usage fees to content holders based on how data users use the data and will provide tools for content holders to manage entrusted datasets. That is intended to lower the risk of unauthorized use of copyrighted works while creating a new revenue opportunity for rights holders, SoftBank said.For AI developers and other data users, the platform offers access to high-quality and reliable Japanese-language data, including both open and closed data, and can reduce lead times and costs associated with collecting and processing data. SoftBank has also set up a dedicated quality operations and improvement team to handle data collection and processing end to end, with ongoing monitoring of data quality, safety evaluations and logic improvements.The beta version is expected to receive data from Kyodo News, Sankei Shimbun, Shinano Mainichi Shimbun, Sports Nippon Newspapers, Daily Tohoku Shimbun, Nara Shimbun, The Mainichi Newspapers and Muroran Minpo. SoftBank signed a business partnership agreement with Kyodo News in May 2025 for development of AI model datasets and AI services.SoftBank plans to add hallucination-prevention logic and a trend API in the future. The hallucination-prevention function would automatically analyze sentence dependencies when entrusted data is stored and process the text while maintaining context. The trend API is intended to provide data users with trend information based on SoftBank's own analysis.The company said GaranAI is the beta codename and the service name may change before formal commercialization.Japan's publishers and news organizations have moved more cautiously than some global digital platforms in allowing content use for generative AI, reflecting concerns over copyright control and compensation. The GaranAI platform adds a structured licensing and processing layer aimed at the domestic Japanese-language data market.SoftBank aims to expand the platform beyond mass media to include web media and other web services, as well as museums, education, manufacturing, retail, local governments and industries tied to strategically important products and technologies.

records.title: Quantinuum and SoftBank Corp. Publish Joint White Paper on Scaling Practical Quantum Computing Use Cases Toward the Fault-Tolerant Era
records.excerpt: TOKYO and BROOMFIELD, Colo., July 21, 2026 /CNW/ -- Quantinuum (NASDAQ:QNT) and SoftBank Corp. ("SoftBank") today announced the publication of "Quantum Computing Frontiers," a joint white paper that maps two commercially-relevant quantum computing application areas against Quantinuum's hardware roa… Quantinuum and SoftBank Corp. Publish Joint White Paper on Scaling Practical Quantum Computing Use Cases Toward the Fault-Tolerant Era 4 minutos de lectura QNT The companies have published a joint white paper mapping commercially relevant quantum computing use cases in quantum chemistry and graph analytics to Quantinuum's hardware roadmap. The paper provides a framework for assessing how advances in quantum hardware and algorithms, could affect when practical industrial applications become feasible. SoftBank Corp. and Quantinuum will use the roadmap to inform their exploration of future quantum AI data center services and related business models. TOKYO and BROOMFIELD, Colo., July 21, 2026 /CNW/ -- Quantinuum ( QNT ) and SoftBank Corp. ("SoftBank") today announced the publication of "Quantum Computing Frontiers," a joint white paper that maps two commercially-relevant quantum computing application areas against Quantinuum's hardware roadmap. The analysis examines how advances in quantum hardware and algorithms could affect when these applications become practical for industrial use. The paper focuses on two representative application domains that SoftBank is actively using Quantinuum's systems to research: quantum chemistry for new materials discovery and energy research, and topological data analysis for large-scale graph analytics, including for telecommunications fraud detection. The authors anchor their assessment of the scalability of these two application areas against Quantinuum's published hardware roadmap, examining how projected advances in hardware capabilities and algorithms may enable the commercial readiness of future industrial applications. Building on this use-case roadmap, the paper also examines how quantum computing, AI, and high-performance computing could be integrated into future computing infrastructure. It considers how progress across successive hardware generations could inform future quantum AI data center services and related business models, a key focus of the Quantinuum and SoftBank partnership announced last year. "The key takeaway of this study is that organizations do not need to wait for large-scale, fault-tolerant systems to explore where quantum computing can begin creating value," said Duncan Jones, General Manager, Applications Group at Quantinuum . "By using today's systems to develop, benchmark and refine applications in areas such as quantum chemistry and graph analytics, enterprises can build the technical and operational readiness needed for the next era of quantum-enabled computing." "The question is no longer whether quantum computing may deliver value, but rather which problem classes become executable at which stage of hardware maturity," said Ryuji Wakikawa, Senior Vice President & CTO at SoftBank Corp . "However, we believe progress in hardware must be complemented by equally strong developments in quantum algorithms and the integration of quantum systems with AI and high-performance computing." The white paper discusses illustrative scenarios describing how representative applications, technology maturity, and potential market opportunities may evolve over time under stated assumptions. The analysis provided in the paper is intended to provide a conceptual framework for understanding potential market evolution and does not represent financial guidance or forecasts. These analyses are intended to support discussion of future technology development and should not be interpreted as commitments regarding commercialization, infrastructure investment, products, services, or financial performance. The full white paper is available to download on the SoftBank and Quantinuum websites. About SoftBank Corp. Guided by the SoftBank Group's corporate philosophy, "Information Revolution – Happiness for everyone," SoftBank Corp. (TOKYO: 9434) operates telecommunications and IT businesses in Japan and globally. Building on its strong business foundation, SoftBank Corp. is aiming to activate the potential of AI across its businesses and drive implementation in line with its "Activate AI for Society" growth strategy. While further growing its telecom business, SoftBank is expanding its AI computing infrastructure and AI and Cloud service businesses with the aim of becoming a provider of Next-generation Social Infrastructure. To learn more, please visit https://www.softbank.jp/en/corp/ About Quantinuum Quantinuum ( QNT ) is a leading quantum computing company offering a full-stack platform designed to make quantum computing deployable in real-world environments. The company has commercially deployed multiple generations of quantum systems built on the well-established QCCD architecture, which it has implemented with novel designs and capabilities to achieve the industry's highest accuracy levels based on average two-qubit gate fidelity.[1] Quantinuum has active engagements with market leaders across pharmaceuticals, material science, financial services, and government and industrial markets. The company has a global workforce of approximately 700 employees, including top scientists and researchers. Over 70% of its technology team holds PhDs or Master's degrees. Quantinuum's headquarters is in Broomfield, Colorado, with additional facilities across the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Japan, Qatar, and Singapore. For more information, please visit www.quantinuum.com . records.label: bbc.co.uk
records.title: Aston Martin secures £550m loan deal
records.excerpt: Aston Martin secures £550m loan deal Image source, Getty Images Image caption, Aston Martin said the loans would be used to fund future product plans Published 22 July 2026 Aston Martin has secured £550m in loans as it attempts to boost its finances. The luxury car maker has been struggling in recent years and in March announced it would cut about 600 jobs, as last year's net losses leapt by a little over 50% to £493.2m. The firm has blamed the effects of US tariffs and weak demand in China. Its half-year results are set to be published on 29 July, but on Wednesday the firm announced loans that it said would bolster its balance sheet and fund future product plans. Headquartered in Gaydon, Warwickshire, most of the job cuts were thought to affect sites in the UK, where the majority of its staff are based. The company has been burning through cash and at the time it announced the job cuts, Aston Martin said the move would mean annual savings of about £40m. Image source, Getty Images Image caption, The Valhalla model went on sale last year The funding announced on Wednesday, managed by HPS Investment, includes a £450m senior secured-term loan, which means it is repayable ahead of other creditors and is backed by specific assets. In addition there is a £100m delayed draw term loan, meaning the funding will be available at specific points, rather than payable upfront. Experts have said Aston Martin has been operating in an increasingly competitive global market in recent years and was particularly susceptible to reduced demand. Chief financial officer Doug Lafferty said in a statement: "This new £550m debt financing significantly strengthens our liquidity, providing us with both additional resilience and further flexibility to execute our current and future product plans." American Honda Announces Sales Leadership Changes Release Photos July 22, 2026 — TORRANCE, Calif., Jessika Laudermilk, currently assistant vice president of Honda National Auto Sales will become assistant vice president of Acura National Auto Sales Luis Guerra, currently Central Region director of Auto Sales will become assistant vice president of Honda National Auto Sales Mike Langel, currently assistant vice president of Acura National Auto Sales will become assistant vice president of Sales at the Honda Aircraft Company American Honda today announced rotational changes to the company’s Auto Sales leadership effective Monday, August 3, 2026. Jessika Laudermilk, currently assistant vice president of Honda National Auto Sales, will move over to lead Acura brand sales as the assistant vice president of Acura National Auto Sales. Luis Guerra, currently Central Region director within Auto Sales, will succeed Laudermilk as assistant vice president of Honda National Auto Sales. Mike Langel, currently assistant vice president of Acura National Auto Sales, will assume a new sales position at Honda Aircraft Company (HACI). “Job rotation has always served as an important strategy in developing our executive leaders for the Honda and Acura brands, advancing knowledge and experience to better serve our customers and dealers,” said Lance Woelfer, vice president of Auto Sales at American Honda Motor Co., Inc. “We are fortunate to have leaders with the depth of experience and proven track records that Jessika Laudermilk and Luis Guerra bring to their new roles leading the Acura and Honda brands. At the same time, Mike Langel’s transition to Honda Aircraft provides an opportunity to leverage his experience as a pilot within the Honda family.” Jessika Laudermilk Jessika Laudermilk joined Honda in 2018 as part of the field sales organization. Over the past two years, she has led Honda National Sales, helping drive record sales of hybrid-electric vehicles for the Honda brand. Her previous roles included serving as assistant vice president of the Marketing Division, where Laudermilk oversaw marketing operations for both the Honda and Acura brands. Her overall experience will be invaluable as Acura prepares to introduce a new generation of vehicles, including the brand’s first hybrid-electric models. Luis Guerra Luis Guerra brings almost two decades of experience with the company to his new role, working within both the Honda and Acura field organizations and Honda National Sales. In addition to his current responsibility as Central Region director, Guerra has served in a variety of sales leadership roles in the company’s Mid-Atlantic, Southeast and North Central Zones. As a member of the United States Army, Guerra served in both Operation Desert Storm and Desert Shield. Mike Langel Since joining American Honda in 2008, Mike Langel has served in a variety of roles within the Auto and Motorcycle Sales Divisions of the company, including both regional and national positions. As the assistant vice president of Acura National Sales for the past two years, he helped guide the brand through challenging business conditions, leading to strong sales momentum in 2026. As an experienced pilot with a passion for flying, supporting HondaJet sales will enable Langel to fulfill a personal dream. About Honda Honda offers a full line of clean, safe, fun and connected vehicles sold through more than 1,000 independent U.S. Honda dealers. The award-winning Honda lineup includes the Civic, Prelude and Accord, along with the HR-V, CR-V, Passport, Prologue and Pilot sport utility vehicles, the Ridgeline pickup and the Odyssey minivan. The Honda electrified vehicle lineup, representing nearly a third of total sales in 2025, includes the all-electric Prologue SUV, hybrid-electric Accord, CR-V, Civic, and Prelude. Honda has been producing automobiles in America for over 40 years and currently operates eight major auto manufacturing facilities in America. In 2025, around 99% of all Honda vehicles sold in the U.S. were made in North America, with about 60% made in America, using domestic and globally made parts. More information about Honda is available in the Digital FactBook. About Acura Acura is a leading premium auto brand committed to delivering expressive styling, innovative engineering and engaging dynamics, all built on the brand's Precision Crafted Performance DNA. The Acura lineup consists of four models: the Integra sport sedan, and the ADX, RDX, and MDX sport-utility vehicles. About 85% of Acura vehicles sold in America in 2025 were made in America, using domestic and globally made parts. More information about Acura is available here: https://acuranews.com/en-US . records.excerpt: Honda Could Increase Its American Investment With Another US Manufacturing Plant 2023-2025 Honda CR-V Hybrid Exterior Honda By Christopher Smith Published Jul 21, 2026, 4:24 PM EDT Chris joined CarBuzz in June 2025. He's held positions at Ford and Motor1, and contributed to Autoblog, Car Throttle, Auto Trader, and many other motoring outlets during his 28-year career. Chris holds a BA in English from Western Michigan University and an AA in Journalism. Growing up in the 1980s in the shadow of Detroit, Chris didn't realize he was witnessing a turning point in automotive history. He just thought digital dashes and pop-up headlights were cool, and no car could ever be as awesome as KITT from Knight Rider. He also came from a car-crazy family, so when he graduated from college with English and Journalism degrees, he applied his communication talents to the wild world of cars. Chris worked as a mechanic and auto detailer through college, and he was knee-deep in the car club scene when the first Fast and Furious film hit the big screen. Early comms jobs at Ford put him in the hot seat of high-horsepower Mustangs, but being a fan of all cars, he started writing on the side as an auto journalist. Sign in to your CarBuzz account Honda had some big electric vehicle plans in America, and that all went up in smoke. The 0 Series, which was planned for production in Ohio, got killed before it had a chance to live. The rebooted Acura RSX was canceled. More recently, Honda announced the Prologue would officially die at the end of the 2026 model year. Failed EV investments have costs Honda billions, and at a glance, it would seem the Japanese brand is in a world of hurt. But, it's not as bad as one might think. Case-in point: Honda sales in America are booming . The company just had its best June in five years with sales up 17% for the month. For the year, American Honda – including sales from Acura – is up 2.4%. Car sales are up 14.1% for the year, and the CR-V is on track to beat the Toyota RAV4 as America's best-selling vehicle that isn't a pickup truck. There is big-time demand for Honda vehicles in the US, and that has Honda CEO Toshihiro Mibe wanting more manufacturing capability to meet that demand. Build More Cars In America, For Americans 2026 Honda CR-V Hybrid TrailSport front three-quarter angle in green while driving Honda The boss of bosses at Honda recently gave an interview with Japanese publication Yomiuri Shimbun , in which he discussed US manufacturing. It seems the company is nearly at capacity in North America, running about 90% per Automotive News . That doesn't leave much wiggle room should demand increase further. And if buyers can't get the vehicles they want in a timely manner, there's a big risk of losing the sale altogether. "It's almost in full production. If you don't have a buffer, you can't recover production," said Mibe. That's why Mibe would love to build another manufacturing plant in the US. Right now, Honda has 12 manufacturing facilities, with seven of those dedicated to assembling cars and powertrain components. The hub is in Ohio, but Honda operates facilities in Indiana and Alabama as well. His ideal plan would add an eighth factory for vehicles. "I want to increase the number of sales in North America a lot. The basic idea is to produce in a place where there is demand.” -Toshihiro Mibe, Honda CEO Can Honda Afford A New Factory Right Now? Honda Engine Plant Construction Honda Of course, wanting something and getting something are two different things. Demand for Honda vehicles is certainly strong, but expansion costs money and Honda just wrote off billions reversing course on its EV plans. In fact, the financial hit was so bad that the company posted its first full-year financial loss in 69 years – going all the way back to when the company first went public. Mibe even allegedly faced something of a coup from former Honda executives, who tried to get him fired as CEO. CarBuzz reached out to Honda in the US in hopes of getting some additional insight. A company spokesperson didn't confirm any plans to build a new factory, but didn't shut the door on it, either: "Honda is continually evaluating our production requirements to support the needs of our customers, consistent with our leading commitment to build products in America, which is now approaching 50 years. The possibility of a capacity increase is always a consideration for the future growth of our automobile business in North America; however, no decisions have been made regarding a new US plant." At least one thing is clear. Honda Civic sales are up 3.3%, CR-V sales are up 6.4%, and Accord sales are up a whopping 32.5% for the year. All these vehicles are built in North America, so if demand continues to rise, Honda may have no choice but to invest in more manufacturing. CarBuzz Insight – Why This Matters: 2026 Honda Accord SE front 3/4 high angle in black while driving Honda Right now, the only thing predictable in the auto industry is that things are largely unpredictable. Political headwinds is a term often tossed around these days, and those headwinds can change day by day, or even hour by hour if something upsets the Trump administration in Washington. But, there is a push for more affordable vehicles and strong sales for Civic, Accord, and CR-V suggest buyers are reconsidering their needs for new family vehicles. The big question is whether that trend will still exist in two or three years – the time it generally takes to get a new plant built and running. Political headwinds will change by then, but if Honda can future-proof its new factory to accommodate multiple scenarios, then there's hardly a downside to expanding in America. records.title: Honda extends GAC Honda China joint venture through 2038
records.excerpt: The deal keeps Honda's first China car venture running longer as competition intensifies in the world's largest auto market amid electrification. KEY POINTS Honda and GAC Group extend GAC Honda joint venture term in China through 2038 GAC Honda, Honda's first China car venture, has sold more than 11 million vehicles cumulatively Extension comes as China's auto market faces tougher competition in electrification and intelligent vehicle technologies Honda has agreed with Guangzhou Automobile Group Co., Ltd., or GAC Group, to extend the term of their GAC Honda automobile joint venture in China through 2038, the Japanese automaker said on July 20.The agreement was signed between Honda Motor (China) Investment Co., Honda's local unit in China, and GAC Group. Honda said the extension would support a further strengthening of its automobile business in China.GAC Honda was established in July 1998 as Honda's first automobile joint venture in China and began vehicle production in March 1999 in Guangzhou, Guangdong province. Honda said the venture built what it described as an integrated four-in-one sales and service network covering sales, after-sales service, parts supply, and customer feedback and management.Cumulative sales at GAC Honda have exceeded 11 million vehicles. Honda said the venture has contributed to the development of China's auto industry.GAC Honda is based in Guangzhou and has registered capital of $867,215,960. Its ownership is split 50% by GAC Group, 40% by Honda Motor Co., and 10% by Honda Motor (China) Investment Co. The general manager is Katsuhide Moriyama.GAC Honda absorbed wholly owned subsidiary Honda Automobile (China) Co. in 2020. Honda said GAC Honda plans to make Dongfeng Honda Engine Co. a wholly owned subsidiary in 2025 and rename it GAC Honda Engine Co.China is the world's largest automobile market and competition has intensified as electrification and intelligent vehicle technologies advance rapidly. Honda has two main vehicle manufacturing partnerships in China, with GAC Group and Dongfeng Motor.

records.title: Honda Might Build a New Factory in North America as It Chases Increased U.S. Sales
records.excerpt: There's no word yet on where the factory would be built and when it might become operational. Honda CEO Toshihiro Mibe told a Japanese newspaper that the company is weighing building a new factory in North America, as reported by Automotive News. North America is Honda's largest and most profitable market, and Mibe says the company wants to build cars where the most demand is.Honda's North American plants are already running at 90 percent capacity, and a new factory would provide more flexibility.UPDATE 7/21/26: This story has been updated with a statement from Honda. Honda may add a new assembly plant in North America, CEO Toshihiro Mibe said in an interview with a Japanese newspaper, as reported by Automotive News. "I want to increase the number of sales in North America a lot," Mibe told Yomiuri Shimbun. "The basic idea is to produce in a place where there is demand."Honda is already deeply entrenched in North America. Two factories in Ohio—in East Liberty and Marysville—crank out some of the company's biggest sellers, the CR-V and Accord, while another factory in Greensburg, Indiana, supplies more CR-Vs and the Civic. Honda's larger vehicles, such as the Odyssey and Pilot, hail from Lincoln, Alabama, and Honda also has assembly plants in Mexico and Canada. Now, Honda may invest even further in the region. North America is Honda's largest and most profitable market, making up around 40 percent of the company's global sales in 2025. But Honda's facilities in the U.S., Mexico, and Canada are already running close to full capacity, prompting Honda to consider a new plant. Automotive News cites numbers from GlobalData that show the company's U.S. factories operating at 85 percent of their 1.2 million total capacity. When you include all North American factories, the utilization rate rises to 90 percent out of a maximum capacity of 1.8 million vehicles. An extra factory would help Honda grow its North American sales even further, while also giving the company some extra leeway to handle supply chain disruptions. "[The existing factories are] almost in full production," Mibe said. "If you don't have a buffer, you can’t recover production."We reached out to Honda to confirm Mibe's comments, and a representative provided the following statement: "Honda is continually evaluating our production requirements to support the needs of our customers, consistent with our leading commitment to build products in America, which is now approaching 50 years. The possibility of a capacity increase is always a consideration for the future growth of our automobile business in North America; however, no decisions have been made regarding a new U.S. plant."While Honda is considering a new factory, the plans seem to still be in their infancy, and it would likely be several years, possibly even a decade, before a new factory would become operational. Still, it could prove pivotal as Honda chases increased market share in the lucrative U.S. market. ➡️ Skip the lot. Let Car and Driver help you find your next car.Shop New Cars Shop Used Cars

records.title: Honda Pivot Continues with Plan for Eighth North American Plant After cancelling its 0 EV project, Honda is considering another North American plant to help grow its hybrid offerin
records.excerpt: Honda plans Eighth North American assembly plant | Car News | Auto123 News Cars for sale Technical Specs Car Guides Car Reviews Our Writers Sell your car Car Releases Auto Shows Top 10 Industry Concept Cars Green Wheels News Honda Pivot Continues with Plan for Eighth North American Plant Honda's Americna HQ, in Torrance, California | Photo: Honda Derek Boshouwers July 20, 2026 After cancelling its 0 EV project, Honda is considering another North American plant to help grow its hybrid offering. Following a strategic retreat from its ambitious all-electric vehicle plans, Honda is preparing to double down on its most profitable market. CEO Toshihiro Mibe recently revealed that the Japanese automaker is planning to build an eighth vehicle assembly plant in North America. Why? For three very good reasons: 1) To boost market share in its most important market; 2) To circumvent potential tariffs that could obstruct its growth in that market; 3) U.S. consumer demand for hybrids and ICE vehicles has soared. How important is North America to Honda? It accounts for somewhere around 40 percent of its global sales. The company currently has seven assembly plants on the continent, including four in the U.S., two in Canada (centered in Alliston, Ontario) and one in Mexico, and they are currently running at 90 percent of their annual 1.8-million-vehicle capacity. “If you don't have a buffer, you can't recover production,” Mibe told Japan’s Yomiuri Shimbun newspaper, emphasizing the need for operational wiggle room as Honda targets a U.S. market share beyond its current 9 percent. For Reason Number Two cited above, we can be fairly sure that by North American plant, Honda means a U.S. plant. But we shall see what the future holds. The Honda logo, at the 2025 Chicago Auto Show | Photo: D.Boshouwers Sharp shift in strategy The potential manufacturing expansion follows a massive, multi-billion-dollar 0-shaped pivot. Shifting consumer sentiment and changes to federal tax incentives in the U.S. led Honda to scrap its entire upcoming 0 Series EV lineup. Just recently, the brand discontinued the GM-built Prologue electric SUV after sales plummeted up to 50 percent in the first half of the year. Rather than chasing an electric market that is currently anemic in the U.S., Honda is redirecting its focus toward high-demand hybrid powertrains. Mibe noted that mainstream American buyers are unlikely to adopt EVs fully for at least another five years, making local hybrid production the smarter, more stable play for the short term. | Photo: Honda Made in the USA An eighth facility would further solidify Honda’s massive footprint as a domestic manufacturing powerhouse. The brand already builds 13 models that rank highly on the Cars.com American-Made Index, with its Alabama plant leading the industry in top-10 ranked vehicles. By expanding local assembly, Honda intends to adhere to its core philosophy of building cars where they are sold, while safeguarding its supply chain against volatile import policies. For now, Honda is maintaining that it has not made any definitive decisions regarding a new plant, including where and when it might set up, and even if it will. But it seems very likely to happen, since the automaker's leadership has made it clear that expanding capacity is the definitive next step. records.title: Acura Is Reportedly Planning a New Three-Row SUV Flagship That'll Slot Above the MDX
records.excerpt: Acura is reportedly revisiting a decades-old plan to make a large SUV, but it won't enter production until 2029. Acura is developing a larger three-row SUV that'll sit atop its lineup, according to a report by Automotive News. The new SUV will reportedly offer a lot more third-row legroom and feature the same hybrid powertrain found in the next-generation Acura RDX and Honda Accord.Dubbed the "Acura XL," plans are still in the preliminary phase, and production isn't expected to start until September 2029.In 2008, Acura teased an ambitious plan to introduce five new products to its lineup. Then the financial crisis happened, and the brand's aspirations for a V-8-powered, rear-wheel-drive platform were thrown in the bin. Acura scaled down its five-vehicle proposal and filed away the rest of its notebooks. However, among those scrapped plans, there was reportedly a larger three-row SUV to sit above the mid-size Acura MDX and compete with luxury brands. It's been a long time coming, but Acura could finally resurrect those old plans and bring the large SUV flagship to life, according to a report by Automotive News.This new vehicle, dubbed the "Acura XL" in documents, is expected to be larger than the MDX and compete directly with competitors such as the Buick Enclave and Lexus TX, which both have more third-row legroom than the MDX. The proposed Acura will be equipped with a newly developed hybrid powertrain, per the AN report, which might help it stand out in a crowded segment. Only the TX and Volvo XC90 currently offer a hybrid version, but that could change by the time the "XL" goes on sale near the end of the decade.This is all still in the preliminary phase, though. In the meantime, Acura's lineup will consist of just three models during a two-year break in production of the RDX; we expect the fourth generation to debut in 2028, featuring the new hybrid powertrain and a complete redesign. Honda and Acura gave us our first look at the future powertrain, along with the redesigned Honda Accord and RDX, back in May. At the time, Honda said the new system would slash costs by over 30 percent and improve fuel efficiency by at least 10 percent. Acura reportedly expects to produce around 40,000 copies of the new flagship SUV per year, but it'll be a while before we see it go on sale, as production isn't expected to start until September 2029.➡️ Skip the lot. records.title: Honda extends JV agreement with GAC Group to 2038
records.excerpt: Honda extends JV agreement with GAC Group to 2038 Honda extends JV agreement with GAC Group to 2038 · Just Auto GlobalData Tue, July 21, 2026 at 5:52 AM CDT 2 min read HMC 601238.SS Japanese automaker Honda Motor has announced that it has reached an agreement with Chinese state-owned automaker Guangzhou Automobile Group Company to extend the term of their vehicle production and sales joint venture, GAC Honda Automobile Company Ltd (GAC Honda), through to 2038. Honda holds 50% of the shares in GAC Honda, including 40% held directly and 10% held by its wholly-owned subsidiary Honda Motor (China) Investment Company Ltd, while Guangzhou Automobile Group owns the remaining 50% of the equity. The joint venture was established in 1998, with production at its first vehicle production line in Guangzhou beginning in early 1999. While cumulative production at GAC Honda has exceeded 11 million units since operations first began, the joint venture has failed to keep pace with China's rapid transition to new energy vehicles (NEVs) in recent years. Sales plunged by 53% to 64,150 units in the first half of 2026. Honda said in a statement: "Today, China has grown into the world's largest automobile market in volume, where competition continues to intensify amid the rapid advancement of electrification and intelligent technologies. By fully leveraging the respective technologies and resources of Honda and GAC Group, and continuing to offer products that meet the diverse needs of customers, Honda will further strengthen its automobile business in China." Honda is understood to be planning to restructure its operations in China, which also include a joint venture in Wuhan with Dongfeng Motor Group, called Dongfeng Honda Automobile Company. The two joint ventures have a combined production capacity of 1.2 million vehicles, split between six vehicle assembly plants. According to local reports earlier this year, the company is considering stopping internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicle production at GAC Honda and closing down an ICE plant, while stepping up efforts to produce battery electric vehicles (BEVs) for the local and overseas markets. Honda Racing Corporation signs Fabio Quartararo Honda Racing Corporation signs Fabio Quartararo Honda Racing Corporation (HRC) are pleased to announce the signing of Fabio Quartararo for the 2027 and 2028 MotoGP World Championship seasons. Quartararo will race for the factory Honda HRC team as the 850cc era of MotoGP begins from 2027. The 27-year-old joined the premier class in 2019 after a record-breaking run in the FIM CEV Moto3 International Championship and four competitive seasons in the Moto3 and Moto2 World Championships. As a rookie in the premier class, Quartararo made his presence known and scored pole position in just his fourth race with a total of six poles and seven podiums in 2019. In 2021 he would take the MotoGP World Championship title, battling to second the following year. The French rider has taken a total of 11 wins, 32 podiums and 21 poles to date in the premier class. Honda Racing Corporation signs David Alonso Honda Racing Corporation signs David Alonso Honda Racing Corporation (HRC) are pleased to confirm the signing of David Alonso on a multi-year contract for the MotoGP World Championship. The 20-year-old Colombian has authored one of the most impressive runs through the lightweight classes in recent times, finishing third as a Moto3 rookie in 2023 before dominating the class the following year. Currently in his second season in the Moto2 World Championship, Alonso took his maiden intermediate class win at the 2025 Hungarian Grand Prix and currently sits fourth overall in the 2026 title hunt. With a total of 20 wins, 30 podiums, and nine pole positions across Moto3 and Moto2, Alonso has continued to surpass expectations. records.excerpt: 2024 Moto3 champion David Alonso signs HRC MotoGP contract MCN Reviews For sale News Insurance MotoGP: David Alonso signs multi-year contract with Honda By Josh Close Follow MCN on Google Add MCN as a preferred source on Google to see more of our latest content Published: 21 July 2026 David Alonso will be a MotoGP rider with Honda in 2027. David Alonso in Moto2 action for Aspar at the Sachsenring. David Alonso celebrates becoming 2024 Moto3 world champion at Motegi. 1 of 3 Honda has confirmed the signing of David Alonso for the 2027 MotoGP season however it’s not yet known which Honda team the Colombian will compete for. The 2024 Moto3 world champion has been linked with Honda for the majority of the year, with reports initially suggesting that he would line-up alongside Fabio Quartararo in the factory team. However, in recent weeks, current LCR Honda rider Diogo Moreira has also been linked with a promotion to the factory setup. The Brazilian has impressed so far in his maiden premier class campaign, and it appears HRC bosses are struggling to come to a decision. As for Alonso, he’s signed a multi-year contract with Honda and much is expected of the 20-year-old in the next few years. Known as the ‘Baby GOAT’, Alonso is a former European Talent Cup (2020) and Red Bull Rookies (2021) champion, as well as being crowned the 2024 Moto3 world champion. In his title-winning 2021 campaign, Alonso broke multiple records throughout the season. Riding for the Aspar team, Alonso broke Valentino Rossi’s lightweight class record for wins in a single season (11) by standing on the top step on 14 occasions. Alonso also holds the record for most consecutive wins (7), as well as the most points in a single season (421), the biggest title-winning margin (165) and the most career Moto3 victories (18). He also equalled the record for most podiums in a single season (15). His time in Moto2 hasn’t been as straightforward. Alonso suffered a shoulder injury ahead of pre-season testing in 2025, which put him on the back foot in the opening rounds. Alonso ended his maiden Moto2 campaign ninth overall with one victory and four further podiums. 2026 has been a more consistent campaign so far, with Alonso currently fourth in the championship. Alonso won at Assen and finished second at Brno, whilst he’s finished inside the top six on six further occasions. Alonso will make his debut on the 2027 Honda machine at the post-race Valencia Test. records.title: Honda confirms David Alonso’s 2027 MotoGP signing, but key detail still missing
records.excerpt: Honda confirms David Alonso’s 2027 MotoGP signing, but key detail still missing | Crash.net Skip to main content Log in Honda confirms David Alonso’s 2027 MotoGP signing, but key detail still missing Honda has confirmed it has signed David Alonso for the 2027 MotoGP season Lewis Duncan Updated: 21 Jul 2026 Share David Alonso © Gold and Goose Honda has confirmed it has signed David Alonso to a multi-year factory MotoGP contract for 2027, but has yet to finalise what team he will actually race with. The 2024 Moto3 world champion has long been rumoured to make the jump to MotoGP next year with Honda, with all reports initially claiming he would be going to the factory squad with Fabio Quartararo . But in recent months, those reports have lessened, with it thought Honda is torn between promoting Diogo Moreira from LCR and replacing him with Alonso. David Alonso, Aspar, 2026 Brazil MotoGP © Gold and Goose Honda has seemingly not made a firm decision on this, following the announcement on Tuesday morning that it had signed Alonso, but not where he will race. A full statement read: “Honda Racing Corporation (HRC) are pleased to confirm the signing of David Alonso on a multi-year contract for the MotoGP World Championship. “The 20-year-old Colombian has authored one of the most impressive runs through the lightweight classes in recent times, finishing third as a Moto3 rookie in 2023 before dominating the class the following year. “Currently in his second season in the Moto2 World Championship, Alonso took his maiden intermediate class win at the 2025 Hungarian Grand Prix and currently sits fourth overall in the 2026 title hunt. “With a total of 20 wins, 30 podiums and nine pole positions across Moto3 and Moto2, Alonso has continued to surpass expectations. “He will make his debut on the 2027 Honda machine at the post-race Valencia Test.” Honda indecision holding up Quartararo announcement Honda’s lack of a decision on where both Alonso and Moreira will race in 2027 has held up the long-expected announcement of 2021 world champion Fabio Quartararo joining the brand. Quartararo’s move to Honda’s factory team was first reported before pre-season testing began, as Yamaha failed to convince him to stay put beyond 2026. The Frenchman said at the recent German Grand Prix: “I don't really know when [the announcement will be, exactly, but for sure it’s not going to be super long. Fabio Quartararo. © Gold and Goose “I think [the official announcement] is more for the public or whatever, but I think I have nothing to hide. It's just that I cannot say.” Moreira has been impressive in his debut MotoGP season with LCR, finishing all but two grands prix in the points so far. He has a best finish of sixth at the Hungarian Grand Prix, with the Brazilian 16th in the standings at the summer break. It’s this strong form that has created a headache for Honda in deciding what to do with Alonso, who is currently fourth in the Moto2 points. Until that is resolved, an official announcement on Quartararo’s future remains on hold. As of now, Honda’s factory team is the only one on the grid who hasn’t announced its line-up for 2027. Alonso's Moto2 team-mate Dani Holgado will move to MotoGP with Gresini Ducati next season, while Maximo Quiles will step up to Moto2 with the Aspar squad in his place. records.excerpt: 【MotoGP】ホンダ、中上貴晶の日本GPワイルドカード参戦を発表！ HRC開発ライダーとして母国凱旋 レース MotoGP ホンダ ロードレース 6時間前 100 0 0 共有 共有する記事 【MotoGP】ホンダ、中上貴晶の日本GPワイルドカード参戦を発表！ HRC開発ライダーとして母国凱旋 リンクをコピー コピーしました X Facebook 保存 Webikeプラス編集部 株式会社ホンダ・レーシング（HRC）は、2026年10月4日にモビリティリゾートもてぎで開催されるMotoGP第16戦日本グランプリに、開発ライダーを務める中上貴晶がワイルドカード参戦することを発表した。2024年までフル参戦していた中上が、開発の成果を実戦で検証すべく母国GPの舞台に挑む。 中上貴晶が実戦でのマシン開発に挑む 千葉県出身の中上は、14歳で全日本ロードレース選手権GP125クラスを全戦全勝で制覇した経歴を持つ。その後、ロードレース世界選手権へステップアップし、Moto2クラスで2勝を挙げるなどの活躍を見せた。2018年には最高峰のMotoGPクラスへと昇格を果たしている。 最高峰クラスでは2018年から2024年まで7シーズンにわたりフル参戦を継続した。2025年からはHRCの開発ライダーに就任し、MotoGPマシンの開発を最前線で支える役割を担っている。今回のワイルドカード参戦は、開発ライダー転向後初の母国GPでの実戦機会となる。 「HRCの競争力向上につながる仕事を」 さらに中上は「母国ラウンドという特別な舞台ですが、ウィークを通じて良いデータを収集し、HRCのさらなる競争力向上につながる仕事をしたいと思います」とコメントし、開発ライダーとしての役割を全うする決意を示した。 records.title: 「日本に最悪のサプライズ」本田圭佑に「韓国代表」監督就任説が急浮上…！W杯で”裏MVP”となった男の「信じがたい未来図」
records.excerpt: サッカー w杯2026年FIFAワールドカップ（北中米大会）―。日本は、ブラジルに1-2で惜敗した。ブラジル代表にで敗れて大会を終えた。森保一監督が率いる日本代表はサッカー王国ブラジルに対し互角の試合を展開するも最後は高い壁を超えることができなかった。ところが…日本とブラジルが熱戦を繰り広げるなかピッチ上の代表選手井所に日本中を熱狂させた男がいた。NHKのサッカーW杯中継で解説席に陣取った本田圭佑（40）だ。 2026.07.22 # スポーツ # テレビ # サッカー 「日本に最悪のサプライズ」本田圭佑に「韓国代表」監督就任説が急浮上…！W杯で”裏MVP”となった男の「信じがたい未来図」 現代ビジネス編集部 ワールドカップの裏MVPは本田圭佑だった スペインが優勝を飾った、サッカーW杯2026年FIFAワールドカップ（北中米大会）。日本はブラジルに1-2で惜敗して、大会を終えている。 森保一監督が率いる日本代表は、サッカー王国ブラジルに対し互角の試合を展開するも、最後は高い壁を超えることができなかった。一方、日本とブラジルが熱戦を繰り広げるなか、ピッチ上の代表選手以上に日本中を熱狂させた男がいた。NHKのサッカーW杯中継で、解説席に陣取った元日本代表の本田圭佑（40歳）だ。 photo by Gettyimages この記事の全ての写真を見る（全4枚） -AD- 「戦術論にとどまらず、選手の焦りや監督の迷い、勝負所の空気をズバズバ本音で切り取る“本田節”に視聴者は一喜一憂したんです。本田の解説を聞くために、地上波のフジテレビが中継した視聴人数とNHKがほぼ肩を並べるという快挙を成し遂げ、テレビ業界の常識を覆す大番狂わせを演じました。アナウンサー顔負けの予定調和を嫌う本田のナマの言葉に、Z世代を中心とした一般層の心を見事に鷲掴みされましたね。まさに本田劇場だった」（民放キー局編成担当） 日本代表の敗退後、本田はその勢いに乗ったまま、自身のSNSで「僕を1年試して。アジア杯で負ければクビでいい」と配信した。事実上の次期日本代表監督への堂々たる立候補宣言だった。これに対し日本サッカー協会の反応は冷たかった。 関連記事 ゆうちゃみ「お股まで洗ってもらってる」と衝撃発言…！令和ギャルが「風呂キャンセル界隈」になった”驚きの事情” フジテレビが佐藤二朗を「見捨てた」ゾッとする理由…「中居正広騒動」が残した、洒落にならない「トラウマ」とは 大野智に古参ファンが「カネの亡者か！」と”大激怒”…個サロの年会費が「３万円強」になった「白々しいワケ」 ＼現代ビジネスの記事を見つけやすく／ Google検索で優先表示 関連タグ # スポーツ # テレビ # サッカー

records.title: ホンダ・レーシングが中上貴晶の日本GPワイルドカード参戦を発表（オートスポーツweb）
records.excerpt: ホンダ・レーシングが中上貴晶の日本GPワイルドカード参戦を発表 7/22(水) 19:17 配信 昨年に引き続きMotoGP第16戦日本GPにワイルドカード参戦が決まった中上貴晶 7月22日、ホンダ・レーシングは、10月2日から4日にかけて栃木県のモビリティリゾートもてぎで開催されるMotoGP第16戦日本GPに、HRC開発ライダーを務める中上貴晶をワイルドカードで起用すると発表した。中上にとっては1年ぶりのグランプリ実戦復帰となる。 2018年からLCRホンダ・イデミツより7年間にわたって最高峰のプレミアクラスにレギュラー参戦してきた中上は、2025年よりHRCの開発ライダーに就任し、ホンダ機の開発作業に深く従事している。 開発担当初年度となった昨シーズンは、第6戦フランスGPと第17戦日本GPに実戦でのテストを兼ねてワイルドカードで参戦したほか、第9戦イタリアGPと第12戦チェコGPでは負傷ライダーの代役として急遽出場するなど、陣営のプログラムを強力にサポートした。 開発ライダーとして2年目を迎えた今季2026年シーズンは、新たなテクニカルレギュレーションが導入される来季2027年に向けた850ccマシンの開発を中心とした業務に集中している。次世代プロトタイプマシンの熟成において、世界選手権で長年培ってきた中上の経験と緻密なフィードバックは、HRCにとって欠かせないものとなっている。 今回の日本GP参戦決定に際し、中上は次のように意気込みを語った。 「日本GPにワイルドカードで参戦できることが嬉しい。開発ライダーとしてマシンの開発に取り組み、テストで積み重ねてきた内容を実戦の中で確認できる貴重な機会となる。ホームグランプリという特別な舞台だけど、週末を通じて良いデータを収集し、HRCのさらなる競争力向上につながる仕事がしたい」 日本中のファンが見守る母国の舞台で、ホンダの新時代に向けた鍵を握る中上の走りに大きな注目が集まる。 [オートスポーツweb 2026年07月22日] 【関連記事】 KTM、エンジン問題を認める。ピット・バイラー「エンジン内部で何かがおかしい」 ベッツェッキ、悪夢の4戦を振り返る 左鎖骨骨折で手術も「何があっても諦めることはない」 ザルコ、カタルーニャGP大クラッシュを語る「シーズンは終わったと言われ、少し泣いた」 バニャイア、右前腕の手術を受ける。夏休み明けのシルバーストンで復帰へ 今季初の転倒を喫したディ・ジャンアントニオ「これもレースの一部。前半戦は7.5点だ」／第11戦ドイツGP

records.excerpt: アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援 – 日刊自動車新聞 2026.07.23(木) 管理者 紙面で読む 会社案内 各種申し込み 購読のご案内 ログイン 購読の ご案内 管理者 紙面で 読む ログイン 検索 トップ 自動車流通 開発・生産 行政・輸送 Home 自動車部品・素材・サプライヤー アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援 自動車部品・素材・サプライヤー , 自動車メーカー , 人事・組織改正 2026年5月29日 11:30 SNSで共有: 井上勝史氏 ホンダと日立が出資する自動車部品メーカーのアステモ（東京都千代田区）は5月29日、ホンダの井上勝史取締役が7月1日付で社長CEO（最高経営責任者）に就任するトップ人事を内定したと発表した。竹内弘平社長CEOは退任する。6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。1963年10月22日生まれ、62歳。福岡県出身。 〈2026/5/29更新〉 SNSで共有: 関連記事 ホンダ、現実路線で四輪事業の収益改善へ 開発費・期間・工数を半減 「開発スピードは世界トップレベルに」 2026年5月15日 05:00 ｜ 自動車メーカー , 企画・解説・オピニオン ホンダ、電動化戦略を見直し EV目標は撤回 2029年度までに次世代HV15モデル投入 新型セダンとアキュラSUVも公開 2026年5月14日 14:10 ｜ 自動車メーカー ホンダ、アステモを子会社化 ソフトやAI開発加速 新規株式公開も視野 2025年12月18日 05:00 ｜ 自動車メーカー , 自動車部品・素材・サプライヤー ホンダ系サプライヤー、EV戦略見直しに「補償求める」「量産前の決断歓迎」などの声 2026年3月13日 05:00 ｜ 自動車部品・素材・サプライヤー 資本再編進む自動車サプライヤー 親子上場の解消 円安で外資も意欲 経営資源集中でEVやSDVに対応 2026年1月1日 05:00 ｜ 企画・解説・オピニオン , 自動車部品・素材・サプライヤー 〈トップインタビュー2026〉三菱電機モビリティ、田中和徳社長 鴻海とのシナジー期待 アイシンとの共同開発に手応え 2026年7月23日 11:30 ｜ 自動車部品・素材・サプライヤー , 連載・インタビュー アクセスランキング 直近 昨日 一週間 ワンソクTubeのブログはこちら 【2026年5月新車販売ランキング50位まで!】新型RAV4や新型CX-5は何位? records.title: アメリカン・ホンダ、自動車販売部門のリーダーシップ変更を発表
records.excerpt: Title: アメリカン・ホンダ、自動車販売部門のリーダーシップ変更を発表 提供 Investing.com URL Source: http://m.jp.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/article-93CH-1612152?ampMode=1 Markdown Content: ## アメリカン・ホンダ、自動車販売部門のリーダーシップ変更を発表 発行済 0001年01月01日 09:00 更新済 2026年07月23日 00:22 ![Image 1: アメリカン・ホンダ、自動車販売部門のリーダーシップ変更を発表](https://i-invdn-com.investing.com/news/world_news_2_108x81.jpg) Investing.com -- アメリカン・ホンダは水曜日、自動車販売部門における人事異動を発表した。変更は2026年8月3日付で発効する。現在、ホンダ全国自動車販売部門の副社長補佐を務めるジェシカ・ラウダーミルクは、アキュラ全国自動車販売部門の副社長補佐としてアキュラブランドの販売を統括する新職に就く。現在、自動車販売部門の中央地域ディレクターを務めるルイス・ゲラは、ラウダーミルクの後任としてホンダ全国自動車販売部門の副社長補佐に就任する。現在、アキュラ全国自動車販売部門の副社長補佐を務めるマイク・ランゲルは、ホンダ・エアクラフト・カンパニーにおける新たな販売職に異動する。 「職務ローテーションは、ホンダおよびアキュラブランドのエグゼクティブリーダーを育成するための重要な戦略として機能してきた。知識と経験を深め、顧客およびディーラーへのサービス向上につなげるものである」と、アメリカン・ホンダ・モーター株式会社の自動車販売部門副社長であるランス・ウェルファーは述べた。「ジェシカ・ラウダーミルクとルイス・ゲラが、アキュラおよびホンダブランドを率いる新たな役職に、豊富な経験と実績を携えて臨むことを心強く思う。また、マイク・ランゲルのホンダ・エアクラフトへの異動は、パイロットとしての経験をホンダグループ内で活かす機会となる。」 ラウダーミルクは2018年にフィールドセールス組織の一員としてホンダに入社した。過去2年間はホンダ全国販売部門を統括してきた。以前はマーケティング部門の副社長補佐として、ホンダおよびアキュラ両ブランドのマーケティング業務を監督した。 ゲラは約20年にわたる同社での経験を新職に持ち込む。ホンダおよびアキュラの両フィールド組織、ならびにホンダ全国販売部門での勤務経験を有する。ゲラは砂漠の嵐作戦および砂漠の盾作戦においてアメリカ陸軍に従軍した経歴を持つ。 ランゲルは2008年にアメリカン・ホンダに入社して以来、同社の自動車・二輪車販売部門においてさまざまな職務を歴任してきた。過去2年間はアキュラ全国販売部門の副社長補佐を務めている。 records.excerpt: サッカー w杯2026年FIFAワールドカップ（北中米大会）―。日本は、ブラジルに1-2で惜敗した。ブラジル代表にで敗れて大会を終えた。森保一監督が率いる日本代表はサッカー王国ブラジルに対し互角の試合を展開するも最後は高い壁を超えることができなかった。ところが…日本とブラジルが熱戦を繰り広げるなかピッチ上の代表選手井所に日本中を熱狂させた男がいた。NHKのサッカーW杯中継で解説席に陣取った本田圭佑（40）だ。 photo by Gettyimages 2026.07.22 # スポーツ # テレビ # サッカー 「日本に最悪のサプライズ」本田圭佑に「韓国代表」監督就任説が急浮上…！W杯で”裏MVP”となった男の「信じがたい未来図」 現代ビジネス編集部 韓国サッカー界が「熱烈オファー」 水面下での争奪戦は民放局だけではない。 「NHKもこの秋に新設するスポーツ番組のメインキャスターに本田を大抜擢しようと動いているという話が浮上中だ」（事情通） photo by Gettyimages -AD- 日本国内のテレビ局が札束攻勢をかけるなか、ここに来てさらに驚愕の情報が飛び込んできた。なんと、低迷が続く韓国サッカー界が、次期ナショナルチームの監督として本田の招聘に動くのでは……と言った話が浮上しているのだ。 「韓国代表は監督人事が迷走を極めており、ファンからの批判が殺到している。そこで、アジアのサッカーを知り尽くし、世界的な知名度と強烈なカリスマ性を持つ本田に白羽の矢が立ったという情報が駆け巡っています。日本代表監督の座を袖にされた本田が、あえてライバル国の指揮官として森保ジャパンの前に立ちはだかる……。彼なら、そんな劇的な展開すら計算ずくかもしれません」（スポーツ紙デスク） まさにアゲアゲノリノリ状態で株がうなぎ上りの本田。日本サッカー協会が持て余した異端児は、世界規模で己の勢力図を塗り替えるかもしれない。「本田劇場」の第2幕が始まる。 【こちらも読む】 ゆうちゃみ「お股まで洗ってもらってる」と衝撃発言…！令和ギャルが「風呂キャンセル界隈」になった”驚きの事情” 関連記事 ゆうちゃみ「お股まで洗ってもらってる」と衝撃発言…！令和ギャルが「風呂キャンセル界隈」になった”驚きの事情” フジテレビが佐藤二朗を「見捨てた」ゾッとする理由…「中居正広騒動」が残した、洒落にならない「トラウマ」とは 大野智に古参ファンが「カネの亡者か！」と”大激怒”…個サロの年会費が「３万円強」になった「白々しいワケ」 ＼現代ビジネスの記事を見つけやすく／ Google検索で優先表示 関連タグ # スポーツ # テレビ # サッカー

records.title: 广汽本田合资续约10年，上半年销量不足7万辆
records.excerpt: 广汽本田合资续约10年，上半年销量不足7万辆 下载APP 10%公司 > 广汽本田合资续约10年，上半年销量不足7万辆 澎湃新闻记者 吴遇利 2026-07-21 10:29 来源： 澎湃新闻 广汽本田合资双方续约10年。 据广汽本田7月20日公告，本田与广汽就双方旗下广汽本田汽车有限公司（以下简称“广汽本田”）合资合作项目正式签署战略续约协议，在股比保持不变的同时将合作期限延长至2038年。 广汽本田方面表示，当前中国已发展成为全球规模最大的汽车市场，并随着电动化、智能化技术的快速发展，竞争日益激烈。在此背景下，本田和广汽集团将充分发挥各自的技术和资源优势，全力推动广汽本田加速重塑核心竞争力，实现向新能源转型，持续提供满足用户需求的多样化产品。 广汽本田于1998年7月成立，是本田在中国负责汽车生产销售的首家合资公司，双方于1998年签订了为期30年的合资合同，即合约于2028年到期。在全球同步车型导入、4S店销售服务模式等多个领域，广汽本田均开创行业先河，截至目前累计整车销量突破1100万台。 近年来，在中国汽车市场成功向新能源汽车转型，以及本土汽车品牌强势崛起的大背景下，广汽本田逐步落后于中国的竞争对手。相较2020年80万辆的高点，广汽本田的销量已经呈现腰斩。 产销数据显示，广汽本田2025年全年销量为35.19万辆，同比下滑25.22%；2026年上半年，广汽本田销量仅为6.83万辆，同比下滑55.82%；今年6月单月，其销量仅1.41万辆，同比下滑53.03%。 作为核心利润来源的合资品牌大幅缩水，导致广汽集团自身的业绩也并不乐观。广汽集团此前披露的2026年半年度业绩预告显示，预计上半年归母净利润为亏损40.6亿元至45.7亿元，扣非净利润为亏损48亿元至56亿元。财报显示，该公司2025年全年净亏损为87.84亿元。 本田方面同样严重承压。财报显示，其2025财年（2025年4月-2026年3月）营业亏损4143亿日元，归母净亏损4239亿日元，系公司自1957年上市来首次整个财年录得年度亏损。其中电动汽车相关业务累计亏损更是高达1.45万亿日元。 责任编辑： 郑景昕 图片编辑： 金洁

records.title: 广汽本田续约至2038年：上半年销量同比下滑55.8%，股比不变背后的财务逻辑
records.excerpt: 广汽本田续约至2038年：上半年销量同比下滑55.8%，股比不变背后的财务逻辑 咖咖Car 2026-07-23 16:16 广汽本田合资续约至2038年，股比维持50:50。2026年上半年总销量68,300辆，同比下滑55.8%；6月单月销量14,099辆，同比下滑53.0%。产能从120万辆缩减至72万辆，削减幅度达40%。 核心数据 2026年H1销量：68,300辆，同比-55.8% 2026年6月销量：14,099辆，同比-53.0% 2025年全年销量：35.19万辆 产能调整：120万辆→72万辆，削减40% 累计用户基盘：超1100万辆 历史对标 五年前广汽本田年销80万辆以上是常态。2025年全年销量已萎缩至35.19万辆，不到巅峰期的45%。2026年上半年仅完成6.83万辆，年化不足14万辆，意味着产能利用率即便按72万辆新基数计算，仍不足20%。 同行对比 日系合资阵营整体承压，但广汽本田的降幅远超均值。同为日系的东风日产2026年上半年销量降幅约30%，广汽丰田降幅约25%。广汽本田55.8%的下滑意味着其市场份额正在加速流失，主力车型雅阁、皓影销量均腰斩，在20万级市场被比亚迪、小米、华为系产品持续挤压。 财务影响 销量腰斩带来的直接冲击是营收锐减和固定成本摊薄能力恶化。以单车均价15万元估算，上半年营收约102.5亿元，同比减少约130亿元。产能削减40%意味着一次性计提资产减值损失的可能性，但中长期可降低折旧和人工成本。广汽集团作为上市公司，广汽本田是其主要利润来源之一，合资公司的利润贡献将大幅缩水。 转型投入 续约协议提及的合作模式转向"技术共创"，引入华为鸿蒙智能座舱和Momenta智能驾驶，2027年计划推出3款全新车型。这类研发投入在销量低谷期会加剧利润压力。研发费用率将被动推高，短期内难以通过规模摊薄。 风险因素 第一大风险是产品节奏。2027年新品投放窗口期，竞品迭代速度极快，若新车市场反响不及预期，产能利用率进一步下滑将形成负向循环。第二大风险是广汽集团整体的利润结构——广汽本田贡献权重下降的同时，广汽埃安等自主品牌尚未实现稳定盈利，集团利润可能面临双重挤压。 续约到2038年锁定了合作框架，但销量下滑55.8%和产能砍掉40%才是当前更真实的信号。 本内容来自网通社号创作者，不代表网通社的观点和立场。 分享到 微信、QQ、支付宝扫一扫手机阅读更方便。

records.excerpt: 4月总销量5100辆！广汽本田同比暴跌72%，黄埔工厂将关停_车家号_汽车之家 文章详情 去App查看 独家引擎 · 河南 关注 4月总销量5100辆！广汽本田同比暴跌72%，黄埔工厂将关停 开年以来，广汽本田的市场表现仍在承受巨大压力。5月7日，据最新披露的销量数据显示，2026年4月广汽本田单月销量仅为5,100辆，同比暴跌72%，跌幅远超行业平均水平，创下品牌入华以来的单月销量新低。 广汽本田此次销量近乎“膝盖斩”，意味着其燃油车基本盘的流失速度正在加快，原有的品牌溢价与用户口碑正在被自主新能源品牌的产品力快速消解。 当前，国内10-20万主流乘用车市场中，新能源车型渗透率已经突破70%，仅靠燃油车优惠促销已经很难留住用户。面对销量颓势，广汽本田预计2027年将集中推出三款全新车型，同时已确认与华为、Momenta等智能科技企业达成合作，试图通过外部技术导入快速补全智能驾驶、智能座舱领域的能力短板。在这个一天一变化的车市，把希望寄托在明年，不知道广汽本田还能不能坚持住？ 另外，因在华销售持续低迷，本田汽车决定削减广州、武汉两地生产基地的燃油车产能，计划关停广汽本田、东风本田合计4座燃油车工厂中的2座，在华燃油车总产能将由目前约120万辆压缩至72万辆，相当于一次性削减约四成产能。 本内容来自汽车之家创作者，不代表汽车之家的观点和立场。 举报/纠错 打开汽车之家App 查看全部评论 相关阅读 数据加载中... 发条有爱评论~ 评论 点赞 收藏 分享 2026-07-23 17:08:54 2026/7/23 17:08:54

1958年，第一辆雪佛兰Impala驶下生产线，很快便成为现象级产品。它不仅设计上足够酷，还被流行文化迅速吸收——《美国风情画》《过眼云烟》等电影里都有它的身影，海滩男孩乐队甚至为它写过歌。上市头三年，Impala卖出约68000辆；五年后，这个数字已突破80万辆。整个生命周期从1958年延续到2020年，雪佛兰累计售出接近1700万辆Impala，期间衍生过1961年的Super Sport以及70年代的双门轿跑、四门轿车、敞篷和旅行车等多种车身形式，几乎覆盖当时所有审美取向。 但放到更长的时间维度里看，Impala的销量纪录仍然被后来者超越。本田雅阁就是其中之一。本田官方曾表示，雅阁是“美国过去50年最畅销的车型”。第一代雅阁直到1982年才问世，起步比Impala晚得多，却用更短的时间累积了更高销量。2026年，本田庆祝了雅阁在美国的第1500万辆交付。国际市场上，根据Good Car Bad Car整理的数据，雅阁还售出约370万辆，全球总销量达到1870万辆，轻松越过Impala的关口。考虑到雅阁至今仍在生产，这个数字还会继续增长。目前2026款雅阁提供多种配置，包括数款混合动力版本，其可靠性口碑也为长期持有带来便利。 同为日系选手的丰田凯美瑞同样把Impala甩在身后。作为前凯美瑞车主，笔者对此早有预感，而销售数据确实支持这一判断。丰田官方数据显示，截至2024年底，凯美瑞全球累计销量已超过2100万辆，Impala约1700万辆的成绩在其面前也显得失色。更早之前，丰田在2023年就宣布凯美瑞连续第22年成为美国最畅销的乘用轿车——这一纪录目前仍在延续。 records.title: 全球销量超1500万辆，城市SUV鼻祖，本田CR-V仅售13.79万起
records.excerpt: 全球销量超1500万辆，城市SUV鼻祖，本田CR-V仅售13.79万起_车家号_汽车之家 文章详情 去App查看 全球销量超1500万辆，城市SUV鼻祖，本田CR-V仅售13.79万起 隔壁说车老王 · 山东 关注 各位车友，我是隔壁老王。做车评这么多年，见证了紧凑型SUV市场几番更迭，新势力电车轮番上新、国产混动疯狂内卷，不少老牌合资SUV销量逐年下滑，可 本田CR-V ( 图片 | 参数 | 询价 ) 依旧稳稳站住脚跟。 5月份东风本田全系销量环比涨两成，单单CR-V一款车就卖出11408台，环比大涨30.4%。放眼全球，这款诞生三十一年、历经六代迭代的城市SUV鼻祖，全球累计销量突破1500万台，国内市场销量突破320万台，实打实靠着家用口碑站稳市场。接连半个月把CR-V、丰田RAV4荣放、大众途观L三款主流竞品轮换试驾，抛开品牌滤镜，站在普通工薪家庭、二胎家用、长途自驾车主的真实用车角度，聊聊CR-V的长处、短板以及未来的市场走向。 CR-V能火三十多年，四大核心优势是立足根本，第一项就是同级拔尖的空间利用率，本田MM造车理念把机械空间压缩到极致，乘坐空间拉满。车身尺寸4703×1866×1690mm，轴距参数放在紧凑型SUV里属于中上水准，实测一米八五驾驶员调好驾驶坐姿，后排腿部还有两拳富余，后排地板近乎纯平，满载三名成年人不挤腿，老人小孩长途坐车舒适度在线。常规后备箱522L，放倒后排座椅直接拓展至1695L，婴儿推车、露营装备、换季大件行李轻松收纳。对比RAV4荣放后排头部空间局促，途观L虽然车身更长，但机舱占用空间偏大，后排纵向表现反而不如CR-V；不少国产SUV看着轴距亮眼，实际被内饰结构侵占空间，车内实用性远不及CR-V经过市场打磨的空间设计。 第二大优势，两套动力适配全场景用车，i-MMD四代混动是它碾压同级的王牌。燃油版搭载1.5T地球梦涡轮发动机，193马力日常超车、高速提速从容，加92号粗粮就行，综合油耗7.5L上下；重点是四代i-MMD混动系统，全球累计销量突破715万辆，市区低速通勤以电机驱动为主，实测拥堵路况百公里油耗低至3.13L，日常通勤综合油耗5L出头，加满一箱油轻松跑900公里，跨省出游不用频繁进加油站补油。反观RAV4双擎市区油耗普遍6L以上，途观L全系需要加注95号汽油，保养费用更高，长期家用油费、维保开销差距明显，没有固定充电桩、偏爱燃油混动的家庭，CR-V混动的用车成本优势一目了然。 第三是安全与保值双在线，家用车最看重的两大硬性指标。全系标配十安全气囊，拿下中保研C-IASI顶级安全评级，也是当年C-NCAP首个超五星评级的城市SUV，还获评五星健康车，内饰用料环保，新车异味小，家里有婴幼儿也能放心用车。三年保值率60.27%，稳居合资紧凑型SUV第一名，开三年转手，折损远低于途观L和一众国产SUV，很多车主换车时才明白，高保值就是省下真金白银。 第四，售后网点遍布全国，用车容错率高。国内深耕多年，县城、地级市随处可见本田4S店，零配件量产充足，小保养价格亲民，路边正规修理厂都能常规养护；对比部分冷门新能源车型，售后网点稀少，零配件订货周期动辄半个月，后期用车便利性差距巨大。 客观聊聊实实在在的短板，帮车友理性避坑。内饰大面积硬质塑料，用料廉价，豪华质感比不上同价位途观L和国产SUV；高速工况下风噪、胎噪明显，隔音是常年被车主吐槽的痛点；原车车机智能化偏弱，语音控制功能简单，和新势力车型大屏生态没法对比，车漆偏薄，细小剐蹭极易留下划痕。选购思路清晰：看重底盘厚重、高速质感选途观L；偏爱自吸平顺、极致省心选RAV4荣放；追求内饰豪华、智能配置选国产混动SUV；日常市区通勤、家用代步、在意油耗和保值，CR-V是稳妥首选。 再分析CR-V后续市场前景，短期销量基本盘很难动摇。当下新能源主攻一二线城市，三四线、县域市场大量车主没有私家充电桩，长途出行电车续航焦虑突出，省油耐用的混动燃油SUV依旧是刚需，CR-V多年积攒的百万车主口碑、成熟混动技术牢牢守住这块市场。长远来看，虽然新能源持续抢占市场份额，但三十一年积累的产品底蕴、完善的供应链体系、高保值标签，让CR-V可以持续优化配置稳住定价，只要持续升级车机、优化隔音细节，未来三五年依旧是紧凑型合资SUV的销量标杆。 在车市价格战、电车扎堆上市的大环境里，CR-V没有靠花哨配置博眼球，专注家用实用，这也是它能穿越市场周期的关键。最后给意向车友带来购车参考：CR-V当前权益价13.79万起，全系现车充足，可预约到店实地试驾体验。 点击展开剩下 0 % 打开汽车之家App 阅读体验更佳 本内容来自汽车之家创作者，不代表汽车之家的观点和立场。 举报/纠错 本田CR-V 暂无报价 看车系 询底价 图片 24422 张 records.title: 过去四年本田销量下滑近60%
records.excerpt: Title: 过去四年本田销量下滑近60% URL Source: http://voi.id/zh/otoinfo/586167 Published Time: 2026-07-23WIB11:23:00+07:00 Markdown Content: 23 Juli 2026, 11:23 | [编辑团队](http://voi.id/zh/otoinfo/586167#) 分享: 雅加达 - 尽管近年来销量持续下滑，但本田重申其继续在中国汽车市场竞争的承诺。据记录，过去四年来，其汽车销量下滑近60%。 Temukan lebih banyak Berita ekonomi Berita hari ini Berita politik 据Carscoops 7月23日星期四报道，这家日本制造商还选择将其与广州汽车集团（GAC）的合资企业延长10年。因此，最初于2028年到期的合作伙伴关系将持续到2038年。 自1999年以来，本田和广汽的合作一直持续。二十多年来，两家公司在中国生产和销售了超过1100万辆汽车。延长合作关系是一个信号，表明本田仍然看到了世界上最大的汽车市场的长期机会，包括在向电动汽车过渡时，预计将更加成熟。 这一举措是在本田在中国销售表现下滑的背景下采取的。2020年，本田通过其两个本地合作伙伴GAC和东风的合并销售额仍达到约162万辆。然而，去年全年，这一数字急剧下降至约64万辆。 在这个数字中，约有34万台来自GAC本田，其余来自东风本田。本田发言人告诉日经亚洲，延长合作的原因。 “尽管业务连续性需要一定的时间，但中国汽车市场正在迅速变化，我们已经做出了这一决定，以评估商业环境，”他说。 然而，与GAC保持合作并不意味着本田的复苏之路将是轻而易举的。中国汽车市场的竞争越来越激烈，特别是因为当地制造商继续通过提供高科技车辆和更具竞争力的价格来巩固其地位。 另一方面，对国内品牌的需求也在不断增加。为了应对这一挑战，本田必须提供能够在技术和价格方面竞争的产品。2024年，该公司在中国推出了Ye电动车系列，包括与GAC联合生产的P7车型以及与东风合作的S7车型。 尽管与西方市场上的本田车型相比，这两款电动汽车在设计和特性上有所不同，但它们尚未能够吸引消费者。这种情况成为本田的家庭作业，以带来下一代产品，更符合中国市场的需求。 * * * _The English, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, and French versions are automatically generated by the AI. records.excerpt: Untelevised Lewis Hamilton team radio as imminent FIA meeting emerges Untelevised Lewis Hamilton team radio as imminent FIA meeting emerges Untelevised Lewis Hamilton team radio as imminent FIA meeting emerges Oliver Harden 23 Jul 2026 7:02 AM Ferrari driver Lewis Hamilton faces the media at the 2026 Belgian Grand Prix Untelevised team radio footage from the Belgian Grand Prix has uncovered the moment Lewis Hamilton insisted that he was in “an impossible position” in his first-lap collision with Mercedes driver George Russell. It comes after PlanetF1.com revealed on Wednesday that Hamilton’s controversial five-second penalty will be raised in a meeting between drivers and the FIA ahead of this weekend’s Hungarian Grand Prix. Lewis Hamilton team radio emerges after FIA penalty over George Russell clash Want more PlanetF1.com coverage? Add us as a preferred source on Google to your favourites list for news you can trust Hamilton and Russell made contact at Les Combes of the opening lap at Spa, with the Mercedes driver spinning into the gravel in the latest blow to his F1 2026 title hopes. Hamilton was handed a five-second penalty for his role in the incident, leaving him in fourth place at the chequered flag. Speaking to PlanetF1.com and other media outlets after the race, Russell, a director of the Grand Prix Drivers’ Association, insisted Hamilton did not deserve a penalty. Russell said: “The incident with Lewis, honestly, I think was a racing incident. He didn’t do anything reckless. It was just one of those things.” Analysis: Belgian Grand Prix Belgian GP conclusions: Spa sacrilege, Russell rattled, Verstappen temptation Belgian GP 2026 Driver Ratings: Antonelli delivers, Verstappen shines, McLaren left wondering PlanetF1.com revealed this week that Hamilton’s penalty , as well as the decision to take no action against Ferrari teammate Charles Leclerc following a collision with Oscar Piastri on the Kemmel straight, will be on the agenda in a meeting between drivers and the FIA in Budapest. Untelevised footage from Spa has revealed how Hamilton protested his innocence after making contact with Russell. The full exchange between Hamilton and his race engineer, Carlo Santi, went as follows: Hamilton : “Car crossed over in front of me. I was right behind another car, so I had no front end.” Santi: “And mode race.” Hamilton: “I don’t know if I have damage.” Santi: “And car looks good, Lewis. Car looks… safety car deployed. Stay out.” Hamilton: “Something flew off… something flew off the front of my car.” Santi: “Understood. And mode safety car.” Santi: “We are checking on cameras. So far seems OK.” Hamilton: “That was an impossible position.” Santi: “Yes, we saw.” Santi: “And target is to keep the tyres where they are now.” Santi: “And you will find a double yellow in 5, 6 and 7 and a recovery car will be on track.” Santi: “And stay in line with the other cars and stay on the left.” Hamilton: “I don’t know if my wing is in one piece.” Santi: “We think the wing is fine. We are checking the floor.” Hamilton: “So unlucky with that turn. Corner.” Ferrari opted against informing Hamilton of his five-second penalty initially. Spa marked the second race in succession that Hamilton was penalised, having also been punished five seconds for a false start at Silverstone. Santi broke the news to his driver as Hamilton was questioning the pit wall’s strategy choice on Lap 18. Hamilton: “When’s the gap clearing up behind? When’s the gap clearing up behind?” Hamilton: “What lap are we on?” Santi: “We are Lap 18.” Hamilton: “Why the hell? I told you what strategy I wanted to do, just to put me out with everyone else now.” Santi: “We are on Plan B.” Hamilton: “Got some understeer.” Santi: “Understood.” Santi: “Virtual safety car deployed. Stay positive.” Hamilton: “What’s the situation?” Santi: “We are boxing if the virtual safety car is staying on.” Hamilton: “Double stack?” Santi: “Both car.” Santi: “Virtual safety car ending, we stay out. Watch your delta, watch your delta.” Santi: “We are opening the gap to Piastri. We need to serve a five-second penalty, that’s why.” Hamilton: “Ah, another one…” The incident with Russell was still playing on Hamilton’s mind at the end of the race as he insisted that the collision was not “my mistake.” However, Hamilton also took the blame for a “tough” weekend, which saw him crash on the exit of the Fagnes chicane in the closing stages of Saturday’s FP3 session. As reported by PlanetF1.com , he had admitted after qualifying that the car “wasn’t the same” following repairs. Santi: “And well done, Lewis. Finish P4. Antonelli won the race, Charles second, Max third. Without the penalty, it would have been an easy podium.” Santi: “And mode charge.” Hamilton: “Yeah, tough weekend guys. That was me – on me. I didn’t feel like it was my mistake today. I just… I’m in the spot I’m supposed to be in. But thanks for continuing to try.” Want to be the first to know exclusive information from the F1 paddock?
